name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud through the Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) Admin APIs: orders and their statuses, product search and edits, catalogs and categories, inventory list records and registered customers. Account Manager API client (client credentials), short code, tenant id and site id.
instructions:
## Salesforce Commerce Cloud
This connector works with the **Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) Admin APIs** of a Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud instance, at `https://SHORTCODE.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com`: orders (read, statuses), products (search, read, edit), catalogs and categories, B2C inventory lists, and registered customers. It is server-to-server with an Account Manager API client; it is separate from the Salesforce CRM connector.

**Setup (about 15 minutes, needs an Account Manager administrator)**
1. In Business Manager open **Administration, Site Development, Salesforce Commerce API Settings** and note the **Short Code** (8 characters) and the **Organization ID** (`f_ecom_` followed by the tenant id, for example `f_ecom_zzrf_001`). The **tenant id** is the part after `f_ecom_` (here `zzrf_001`).
2. In Account Manager (`https://account.demandware.com`) open **API Client, Add API Client**. Set a password (this becomes the client secret) and token endpoint auth method `client_secret_basic`.
3. Under **Roles** add `Salesforce Commerce API` and, as its tenant filter, your tenant id.
4. Under **Allowed Scopes** (and Default Scopes) add exactly: `sfcc.orders.rw sfcc.products.rw sfcc.catalogs sfcc.inventory-lists.rw sfcc.customerlists sfcc.customergroups`. Save and make sure the client is active.
5. Enter the short code in `SFCC_SHORT_CODE`, the tenant id in `SFCC_TENANT_ID`, the site id (for example `RefArch`, from Merchant Tools, Sites) in `SFCC_SITE_ID`, and the API client id and password in `SFCC_CLIENT_ID` and `SFCC_CLIENT_SECRET`.

The connector asks `https://account.demandware.com/dwsso/oauth2/access_token` for a client-credentials token with the scope `SALESFORCE_COMMERCE_API:` plus your tenant id and the scopes above, and reuses it until it expires (about 30 minutes). One token covers one instance (tenant); for staging and production install the connector twice.

**Where to start**: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_orders` (newest first, filter by status and date), then `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_order`. For products `salesforce_commerce_cloud_search_products` with a phrase, then `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_product`.

**Orders**: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_orders`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_order`. Statuses: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_shipping_status`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_export_status` (an OMS or ERP marks orders exported; this finalizes their inventory), `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_confirmation_status`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_external_status`. `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_status` (can cancel or fail an order) and `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_payment_status` are installed switched off. No tool refunds, captures or otherwise moves money, and none creates orders.

**Products and catalogs**: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_search_products` (phrase in id and name), `salesforce_commerce_cloud_query_products` (full query: catalogId, categoryId, lastModified, online, type), `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_product`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_product_variations`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_product`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_catalogs`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_categories`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_category`. Text fields are localized objects (`default` plus locales such as `de-DE`); online and searchable flags are per site.

**Inventory**: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_inventory_list`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_inventory_record` and `salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_inventory_record` work on B2C inventory lists (Merchant Tools, Products and Catalogs, Inventory) by list id and product id; there is no call to list all records of a list. Omnichannel Inventory (OCI) is not covered.

**Customers**: `salesforce_commerce_cloud_search_customers` (phrase in customer number, e-mail, names, company), `salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_customer`, `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_customer_addresses` and `salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_customer_groups`. Customer lists are often named after the site; see Merchant Tools, Customers, Customer Lists.

**Site and ids**: the site id set on the connector (`SFCC_SITE_ID`) is used when a tool's site_id is left out; order calls fail without one. Product, category and order ids are strings; the orderNo is the number the shopper sees. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

**Paging and limits**: lists take limit and offset (orders, product and customer search up to 200 per page, catalogs, categories, variations, addresses and groups up to 50). Order lists return no total and stop at offset plus limit 10,000: narrow by date. Search answers carry total. Salesforce throttles busy instances: 429 comes with Retry-After in seconds, 503 means load shedding, 504 means the call took longer than 60 seconds. Errors are problem documents with `title` and `detail`; 403 with "Access denied for organization" means the tenant id or the role tenant filter is wrong, and a 403 on one API means its scope is missing from the API client.
instructionFacts: The default site of this connector is {{SFCC_SITE_ID}}: tools use it when site_id is left out.

SFCC_SHORT_CODE.label: Short code
SFCC_SHORT_CODE.help: Business Manager, Administration, Site Development, Salesforce Commerce API Settings: the Short Code (8 characters).
SFCC_SHORT_CODE.patternMessage: The short code has 8 letters and digits, for example kv7kzm78.

SFCC_TENANT_ID.label: Tenant id
SFCC_TENANT_ID.help: The Organization ID without its f_ecom_ prefix: for f_ecom_zzrf_001 enter zzrf_001 (realm, underscore, instance).
SFCC_TENANT_ID.patternMessage: Enter the tenant id such as zzrf_001 or abcd_prd, without f_ecom_.

SFCC_SITE_ID.label: Site id
SFCC_SITE_ID.help: The id of the storefront site, for example RefArch (Business Manager, Administration, Sites, Manage Sites). Tools use it when no site is given; the order tools need a site, so set it unless you always name one.
SFCC_SITE_ID.patternMessage: Enter the site id, for example RefArch.

SFCC_CLIENT_ID.label: API client id
SFCC_CLIENT_ID.help: Account Manager, API Client: the client id (a UUID) of the client with the Salesforce Commerce API role.
SFCC_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the API client id, for example a1b2c3d4-0000-1111-2222-333344445555.

SFCC_CLIENT_SECRET.label: API client password
SFCC_CLIENT_SECRET.help: The password set on the API client in Account Manager.

401.hint: Account Manager issued no token. Check the API client id and password, that the client is active, and that its token endpoint auth method is client_secret_basic.

verifyHints.400: Account Manager refused the token request. invalid_scope means a scope is missing from the Allowed Scopes of the API client: add all six listed in the setup steps.

403.hint: The token was refused for this organization or API. Check the tenant id (Organization ID without f_ecom_), the Salesforce Commerce API role with your tenant id as tenant filter, and the scopes of the API client.

verifyHints.404: Nothing found with that id. If every call answers 404, check the short code and the site id.

unreachable.hint: No Commerce API host answers for this short code. Copy it from Salesforce Commerce API Settings in Business Manager.

verifyHints.rate_limited: Salesforce throttled the instance. Wait for the Retry-After seconds and try again.

prerequisites: A Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud instance and an Account Manager administrator who can create an API client with the Salesforce Commerce API role and the scopes listed in the setup steps. About 15 minutes.

authConfig.scope: SALESFORCE_COMMERCE_API:{{SFCC_TENANT_ID}} sfcc.orders.rw sfcc.products.rw sfcc.catalogs sfcc.inventory-lists.rw sfcc.customerlists sfcc.customergroups

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders of a site, newest first by default: orderNo, status, paymentStatus, shippingStatus, exportStatus, confirmationStatus, creationDate, lastModified, currency, orderTotal, customerInfo, productItems, shipments and billingAddress. Up to 200 per page; offset plus limit may not pass 10,000. No total is returned: a page shorter than limit is the last.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

status.description: Order status, one or two comma-separated: created, new, completed, cancelled, failed, failed_with_reopen.

payment_status.description: Comma-separated, up to 3: not_paid, part_paid, paid.

shipping_status.description: Comma-separated, up to 3: not_shipped, part_shipped, shipped.

export_status.description: Comma-separated, up to 3: not_exported, ready, exported, failed.

creation_date_from.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 UTC, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

creation_date_to.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 UTC.

last_modified_date_from.description: Changed at or after, ISO 8601 UTC.

last_modified_date_to.description: Changed at or before, ISO 8601 UTC.

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by order number: statuses, customerInfo (customerNo, email), billingAddress, productItems (productId, productName, quantity, price, tax), shipments with shipping address and method, paymentInstruments (method, amount; card data masked), orderTotal, taxTotal, currency and custom c_ attributes.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_shipping_status
tools.description: Set the shipping status of an order: not_shipped, part_shipped or shipped. Answers 204. The shopper is not notified by this call.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_export_status
tools.description: Set the export status of an order (whether your OMS or ERP picked it up): not_exported, ready, exported or failed. Setting exported finalizes the inventory transactions of the order. Answers 204.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_confirmation_status
tools.description: Set the confirmation status of an order: confirmed or not_confirmed. Answers 204.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_external_status
tools.description: Set the external status of an order, a free value your OMS or ERP uses (for example IN_PICKING). Answers 204.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_status
tools.description: Set the order status: created, new, completed, cancelled, failed or failed_with_reopen. Cancelling or failing an order releases its inventory and cannot simply be reversed. Installed switched off.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_order_payment_status
tools.description: Set the payment status flag of an order: not_paid, part_paid or paid. It only changes the flag (no money moves), but finance and OMS processes rely on it. Installed switched off.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_search_products
tools.description: Search products by a phrase in their id and name (Admin Products API): total and hits with id, name, type (master, variant, item, set, bundle), online, searchable, brand, ean, price, inStock, ats and image, depending on expansions. Up to 200 per page.

search_phrase.description: Words to find in the product id or name.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_query_products
tools.description: Search products with a full Salesforce search query: term, text, range and bool queries on id, name, online, searchable, type, creationDate, lastModified, catalogId and categoryId. Returns total and hits. Up to 200 per page.

query.description: Search query, for example `{"termQuery":{"fields":["catalogId"],"operator":"is","values":["storefront-catalog"]}}`, `{"rangeQuery":{"field":"lastModified","from":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"}}` or `{"matchAllQuery":{}}`. Combine with `{"boolQuery":{"must":[...]}}`.

sorts.description: Sort clauses, each with field (id, name or creationDate) and sortOrder asc or desc.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id: name, descriptions, type, brand, ean, upc, manufacturer, online and searchable per site, price and currency, ats and inStock, image groups, assigned and primary categories, variation attributes, variants, product options, set and bundle members, and custom c_ attributes.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_product_variations
tools.description: List the variants of a master product: productId, variationValues (for example color and size) and online flag. Up to 50 per page.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_product
tools.description: Change product fields (partial: only the fields sent). Text fields are localized objects such as `{"default":"Blue shirt","de-DE":"Blaues Hemd"}`; onlineFlag is per site, such as `{"default":true,"RefArch":false}`. Custom attributes that do not exist are ignored. Changes reach the storefront after the next cache refresh.

online_flag.description: Online flag per site, for example `{"default":true}`.

searchable.description: Searchable flag per site, for example `{"default":true}`.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_catalogs
tools.description: List the catalogs of the instance: id, name, description, online, isMasterCatalog, assignedSites, rootCategory and the category and product counts. Up to 50 per page.

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_categories
tools.description: List the categories of a catalog: id, name, parentCategoryId, online, position, description and page metadata. Up to 50 per page.

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_category
tools.description: Get one category of a catalog with its subcategories down to the given depth: id, name, online, parentCategoryId, categories and page metadata.

levels.description: Depth of subcategories to include: 0 (none), 1 (default) or 2.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_inventory_list
tools.description: Get one B2C inventory list: id, description, defaultInStockFlag, useBundleInventoryOnly and the sites it is assigned to.

inventory_list_id.description: Inventory list id, for example inventory_m (Merchant Tools, Products and Catalogs, Inventory).

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_inventory_record
tools.description: Get the stock of one product in one inventory list: allocation (amount, resetDate), stockLevel, ats (available to sell), turnover, quantityOnOrder, perpetualFlag, inStockDate and pre-order or back-order handling.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_update_inventory_record
tools.description: Set the stock allocation of one product in one inventory list (partial update). The allocation replaces the current amount; ats then becomes allocation plus pre-order allocation minus turnover. Answers with the updated record.

allocation.description: New allocation amount (stock quantity), 0 or more.

perpetual_flag.description: true: always in stock regardless of allocation.

in_stock_date.description: Expected in-stock date, ISO 8601, for back-orders.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_search_customers
tools.description: Search registered customers of a customer list by a phrase in customerNo, email, first name, last name or company: total and hits with customerNo, email, firstName, lastName, phone numbers, creationDate, lastLoginTime and credentials.login. Up to 200 per page.

customer_list_id.description: Customer list id; often the same as the site id (Merchant Tools, Customers, Customer Lists).

search_phrase.description: Text to find, for example an e-mail address or a last name.

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_get_customer
tools.description: Get one registered customer: customerNo, email, firstName, lastName, phone numbers, birthday, gender, companyName, creationDate, lastLoginTime, previousLoginTime, credentials (login, enabled, locked) and custom c_ attributes.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_customer_addresses
tools.description: List the saved addresses of a customer: addressId, firstName, lastName, address1, address2, city, postalCode, stateCode, countryCode, phone and preferred. Up to 50 per page.

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.

tools.name: salesforce_commerce_cloud_list_customer_groups
tools.description: List the customer groups of a site: id, description, type (static or dynamic) and rule. Up to 50 per page.

site_id.description: Site id, for example RefArch. Leave it out to use the site set on the connector (SFCC_SITE_ID).

offset.description: Rows to skip, from 0. Add limit to it for the next page.
